profile.name: Walter James Mitchell
profile.lives in: San Mateo, California, in his own house in the Baywood neighborhood, with his wife
profile.former job: Civil engineer with Caltrans for 35 years; worked on Bay Area bridge retrofits; retired in 2021

preferences: Prefers short, plain answers; likes a bit of dry humor
Drinks black coffee in the morning, decaf after noon
Loves 1960s and 70s music, especially The Beach Boys and Creedence Clearwater Revival
Feels calm talking about bridges, baseball and his woodworking projects
Big San Francisco Giants fan; listens to games on the radio
Dislikes being rushed and noisy restaurants
Gets restless in the late afternoon; a walk usually helps
Does not like being told he already asked something
people: Wife: Margaret (Maggie), 65, retired librarian, primary caregiver, married since 1984
Son: Daniel, 39, firefighter, lives in Redwood City with his family, visits on Sunday afternoons
Grandson: Leo, 10, plays Little League; Walt never misses his Saturday games
Granddaughter: Maya, 6, loves feeding the ducks with him
Daughter: Emily, 36, high school teacher in Portland, Oregon; FaceTimes on Thursday evenings
Older brother: Frank, passed away in 2023 (caregiver says: gently redirect, do not repeat the news)
Best friend: Ray Alvarez, 69, former Caltrans colleague, plays chess with Walt on Tuesdays
Neighbor: Mr. Chen, 70, trades tomatoes and gardening tips over the fence
Church friend: Barbara, 68, drives him to the men's breakfast group on Fridays
Doctor: Dr. Patel, neurologist at Mills-Peninsula, check-up on the second Wednesday of each month
routines: Wakes at 6:30 and lets Buster out
Black coffee and the newspaper crossword at 7:00
Breakfast at 7:30, morning medicine with breakfast (Margaret gives it)
Walks Buster around Central Park in San Mateo at 9:00
Woodworking in the garage from 10:00 to noon
Afternoon walk at 4:00 to Coyote Point or the Japanese Garden
Dinner at 6:00, evening medicine with dinner (Margaret gives it)
Friday: men's breakfast group at church at 8:00
Saturday morning: Leo's Little League game
facts: Builds birdhouses and small wooden toys for his grandkids in the garage
Hobbies: woodworking, crossword puzzles, Giants baseball, chess, tomato gardening, walking Buster
Worked on the seismic retrofit of the San Mateo-Hayward Bridge and loves telling stories about it
Grows tomatoes and zucchini in the backyard
Served in the Army Corps of Engineers from 1977 to 1981
Favorite meal is Margaret's pot roast; favorite treat is a See's Candies peanut brittle
Proudest day: watching the Giants win the 2010 World Series with Daniel
likes_to_know: When is Leo's Little League game?
Did I take my morning medicine?
